scope: Configuration-specific peak-bias investigation; no detection significance or calibrated mass precision

validation_policy.data: original analytic mock plus original sigma=0.01 noise
validation_policy.initialization: same truth-derived source nodes and zero potential for every candidate
validation_policy.selection: Independently choose maximum finite full-dense local-Gauss-Newton evidence among converged fits on the identical candidate set; no truth or control-amplitude metric enters selection

evaluation.note: These are diagnostic comparison thresholds, not calibrated false-positive probabilities. Background error and local aperture integrals must also be reported.

validation_policy.limits: Finite development-chosen grid; source strength fixed; invalid candidates excluded with failures retained; upper-edge control choice is not an established continuous optimum; no nonlinear evidence or mass-uncertainty calibration. Policy recorded before fitting held-out seeds.

selection.rule: Choose maximum finite log evidence among converged fits independently for each observation; identical candidate set and fitting controls; no truth metrics used

frozen_linear_bias_decomposition.scope:
Exact frozen-linear decomposition of prior, representation, and noise effects.

This diagnostic does not claim an exact nonlinear bias decomposition. It uses
the public single-step design/prior and verifies superposition against its fit.
